charts.title: K2-239 c: orbits around K2-239
charts.description: The orbits of K2-239's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-239 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Díez Alonso et al. 2018 (2018MNRAS.480L...1D), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname D_IACUTE_EZ_ALONSO_ET_AL__2018): P 7.775 d
